title: skill-creator evals.json
description: Eval cases for a Claude Code Agent Skill, in the format skill-creator (https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/skill-creator) reads and grades.

$schema.description: Points editors and validators at this schema; not part of skill-creator's own evals.json format.

skill_name.description: Must match the skill's SKILL.md frontmatter `name`.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for the case.

prompt.description: The realistic user task to execute.

expected_output.description: Human-readable description of what success looks like.

files.description: Optional input file paths, relative to the skill root.

expectations.description: Verifiable statements graded against the run's outputs and transcript.
